§6Basic Backpack§f

§aYour first step toward not drowning in your own inventory§f

Tired of leaving half your mining loot on the ground? The Basic Backpack gives you §e18 extra slots§f of storage that wear in your §bchest armor slot§f, so it won't conflict with your tools or armor.

§6Crafting§f:
Surround a §bChest§f with §e4× Wool§f in the corners and §e4× Leather§f on the sides. Quick and cheap.

The Basic Backpack supports §e4 upgrade points§f for functional modules, but it can't be specialized into Storage or Upgrade paths. That comes at the next tier.

§ePS:§f Craft a few of these early. You'll need one as an ingredient when upgrading to Iron tier, and having spares for different loadouts is never a bad idea.
